coordinate_units: Unchanged source numeric units; no mesh position correction.

profile_evidence.basis: The real-time cutscene shots (nov_mayor_rt_shot2 to shot7) diverge under the two rules. Under the default segment_scale_compensation_bit0 (SSC0) rule, shots 5 and 6 collapse into shattered geometry in the Blender bake. Under full inheritance the same samples give coherent poses (knee bend, head angle, arm placement) in shots 4 to 7; shots 2 and 3 are nearly unchanged.
profile_evidence.consistency: Visual review of renders from the cached samples, one frame per shot. Pixel-level difference between the two rules is largest in shots 4 to 7.
profile_evidence.scope: Selects the full inheritance rule for this exact source model (npc_mayor). Not a capture-verified in-game claim; the cane grip was not verified at close range.
